PUNCH, LACRYMAL BONE, BEYER'S PATTERN 



1. Scope — Covers dimensional and other requirements for Beyer's pattern Ia v crymal bone punches. 

2. Shape and Dimensions — As shown in Fig. 1. 





ENLARGED 
SECTION XX 




ENLARGED 
SECTION YY 

All dimensions in millimetres. 
FIG. 1 PUNCH, LACRYMAL BONE, BEYER'S PATTERN 

3. Material — Stainless steel conforming to Designation 30 Cr 13 of IS: 6603-1972 'Specification 
for stainless steel bars and flats'. 

3.1 The screw shall be made of the same material as punch. 

4. Workmanship and Finish — The forceps shall be free from burr?, pits, cracks and other 
surface defects. The edges shall be even and rounded. The- joints shall work smoothly without 
undue shake or play, the punch shall be passivated and the handle shall have matt finish. 

5. Heat Treatment 

of 400 to 460 HV. 



■The instrument shall be uniformly hardened and tempered to give a hardness 



6. Tests 

6.1 Corrosion Res/ stance Test — The forceps shall be tested In accordance with IS : 7531-1975 
'Method for boiling and autoclaving test for corrosion resistance of stainless steel surgical 
instruments'. The forceps shall show no sign of corrosion after the test. 

6.2 Performance Test — The forceps shall be made to punch curried leather of 1 mm thickness by 
pressing the arms with moderate force. The forceps shall make a clean and neat punch without 
damage to its punching tips. The punch shall function in the normal manner after the test. 

7. Marking — Each forcep shall be legibly and indelibly marked with the manufacturer's name, 
initials or recognized trade-mark. 

7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

8. Packing — As agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier.
